# Spitfire Audio under Cabinet

- **The prefix stays on `wine-d2d1-dcomp-11.0-777`.** On 11.0-887 (p2 and p3 alike) the Spitfire
  Audio app's sign-in page takes the email but never the password: it answers "Password cannot be
  blank" and never finishes signing in. The same scenario signs in on 777.
